### [Force-matching device](tools/force-matching.qmd){.title}

Two force channels sampled together, machined in-house because nobody sells
one. Every lab running this paradigm has had to build its own.

### [Beads task](tools/beads-task.qmd){.title}

Probabilistic reasoning with every draw logged, so the data can be modelled
instead of collapsed into draws to decision.
:::

::: {.entry}
::: {.meta}
Python / TAPAS &middot; [to publish]{.status}

### [HGF analysis pipeline](tools/hgf-pipeline.qmd){.title}

Fitting, parameter and model recovery, and Bayesian model selection. The
recovery simulations ran before any participant was seen.
:::
